title: EventBus listener removal during emit contract

contract.emit_snapshot: Each emit operates on a snapshot of the listener registry taken before delivery
contract.current_emit_isolation: A listener removed during an active emit still receives the current event because it belongs to the emit snapshot
contract.subsequent_delivery: A listener removed during one emit does not participate in subsequent emits
contract.ordering: Existing listeners retain deterministic registration order
contract.registry_stability: Listener removal during delivery does not corrupt the registry
contract.idempotent_removal: Removing an already removed listener returns False without mutating the registry
contract.source_integrity: Source payloads remain unchanged after emits and listener removal
